what: A video Section pinned to the screen opens and covers like a theater curtain — while the Section scrolls, the bottom edge of the panel’s clip-path becomes a semicircular convex fold at each fold (8 wide on wide screens · 4 wide on narrow screens) rising and falling. Reveal: the drooping folds above lift away and the panel is uncovered from the bottom, and cover: rounded head folds rise from below and hide the panel. Convex depth is .3 of the fold width, oscillates ±.4 with progress 1.75 times and each fold lags by .12, and fold positions are uneven by .02 using sin and sway sideways by .035. With drift set, the folds flow sideways with progress

options.mode: reveal · cover (default) · both — reveal only·cover only·both (first half reveals, second half covers)
options.folds: Number of folds on wide screens (992px and up), default 8
options.length: Scroll length used for one open or cover (in screen heights), default 1 — with both it is doubled
options.drift: Number of folds the ripples flow sideways over progress 0→1, default 0 (source video Section 2)
options.[data-fx-part=screen]: Panel to cover with the veil (video, photo, text). Sticks to the screen inside the section
options.--fx-before / --fx-after: Color shown where the panel is hidden: the previous section’s color while opening, the next section’s color while covering. Empty means transparent, so the stacked next section shows through (original hero: pull the next section -100svh to lay it underneath)
options.hold: In both, the scroll length (in screen heights) the fully opened panel stays before being covered, default 0

use: Video·Title

from.where: index.html .pp-hero (cover · length 1) · .pp-video (both · length .5 · hold 1 · drift 2) — original shutter-scroll-transition: uneven .02 · depth .3 · bounce .4 · swings 1.75 · lag .12 · sway .035 · fold 8/4

note: Section height is set by the part (100svh × (1 + length)). The color outside the board is up to the consuming side’s variable
